The '''Hewett system''' was located in the [[Hewett sector/Legends|Hewett sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was linked via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Vectinia system/Legends|Vectinia system]] as well as the [[Er'Kit system/Legends|Er'Kit system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The Hewett [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hewett]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Hewett [[Senator/Legends|senators]] represented the system in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="JE" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]'' establishes that [[Hewett]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] were a part of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] while [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was still alive. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates Jinn's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Hewett must have gained Senate representation by that date.</ref> By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Hewett system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] triumphed over the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]] in a [[Battle of Hewett|confrontation]] at the system.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hewett system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" />
